text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard hf/llama3-7b into model-catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:30 PT. Need someone to kick off a staging canary + smoke and own rollback readiness. Who can take deploy?

jonathan: I can trigger the canary at 09:30 PT. I'm available then. What exact pin/version are we using?

maya: Pin string: `hf/llama-3-7b:1.2-q4_0`. Plan: canary in staging (5% traffic), run smoke suite, if green promote to prod at 10:15 PT. Fallback pin: `llama-3-7b:1.1-q4_0`.

anya: I'll assemble the smoke prompts + perf targets. Proposed thresholds: p50 < 120ms (batch=1), p95 < 400ms on staging, embedding cosine > 0.98 vs baseline for canonical inputs. I'll post checklist in a sec.

sam: pinging infra: @infra-ci — can you confirm GPU pool availability for the canary window (9:30-11:00 PT)? Need 1 x a100-dedicated reserved.

infra-ci: Capacity check OK. 1 a100 reserved and marked for job window. Autoscale policy temporarily relaxed for canary.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued -> job_id=canary-1764509123-01. Will post status updates here.

maya: Smoke checklist (short):
1) /health -> 200 for new model endpoint
2) sanity prompts (short conversational prompts) -> no truncation, coherent output
3) perf p50/p95 within thresholds
4) KV-cache warmup: token reuse & latency regression check
5) embedding consistency: cosine >= 0.98 to baseline vectors
6) tokenization parity: same token counts for canonical prompts
7) function-calling schema validation (if applicable)
Additions?

anya: Add: output size parity (token counts) and JSON schema strictness for function-calls. I'll create the smoke PR with harness and example prompts: `tests/smoke/llama3/`.

jonathan: I'll tail logs and metrics during canary. If any 5xx or p95 > 400ms or embedding cosine < 0.98 I'll trigger rollback. Preferred rollback path: pin revert via catalog.

sam: Rollback runbook for quick reference: `redwoodctl catalog pin --model hf/llama-3-7b --version 1.1-q4_0` OR console -> Revert pin. That immediately flips routing. Also disable canary traffic and drain new instances.

maya: Also set ephemeral monitor: alert to #eng-oncall if error-rate > 5% sustained over 5m. Can someone add that monitor?

anya: I'll add the monitor as part of the smoke PR. Will post the alert config.

deploy-bot: Canary job started. job_id=canary-1764509123-01. status=running. streaming logs: `tail -n 50 /var/log/deploys/canary-1764509123-01.log`

jonathan: Kicking off canary now. Running smoke suite.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 30% tasks complete. health=OK, container startup=OK.

anya: Ran initial tokenization and embedding checks — small mismatch on ~3/200 canonical prompts (token counts differ by 1). Posting examples in PR.

maya: Hold on promotion. @jonathan please pause further rollout. If it's tokenizer-related we may patch rather than rollback, but we need reproduction and quick fix plan.

jonathan: Investigating — seems tokenizer update in v1.2 changed bytepair splits for a handful of cases. Reproduced locally. ETA for patch ~30m. If patch is small we can rebuild and re-run smoke.

sam: GPUs still reserved. I'll keep the pool pinned until 12:00 PT. Ready to run rollback command if you want me to execute it.

maya: Let's try patch-first. If patch blocks > 45m then rollback to 1.1. Keep rollback command on standby.

deploy-bot: Canary job paused by user at 1764509425. status=paused.

jonathan: Pushed tokenizer patch branch `fix/tokenizer-parity-llama3`. Building a new image, kicking a staging canary build now.

deploy-bot: New canary job queued -> job_id=canary-1764509123-02 (uses image from `fix/tokenizer-parity-llama3`).

anya: Re-running smoke harness against job_id=canary-1764509123-02. Starting tokenization parity check and embedding stability.

deploy-bot: Canary job canary-1764509123-02 completed. results: health=OK, tokenization parity=PASS (200/200), embedding cosine mean=0.993, p50=110ms, p95=280ms.

jonathan: Patch validated. No functional regressions found in smoke. Logs look clean.

maya: Excellent. Jonathan, can you merge the patch PR and then proceed to promote catalog entry to prod at 10:15 PT? I'll approve the PR now.

jonathan: Merged PR and promoted model-catalog staged entry to prod. `catalog::pin -> hf/llama-3-7b:1.2-q4_0` applied at 10:17 PT.

sam: Observability note: production rollout shows p50=115ms p95=320ms, error-rate < 0.2%. GPUs scaled as expected.

anya: Smoke suite results archived: `ci-artifacts/smoke/llama3/1764509123`. Added eval summaries and the test vectors used.

maya: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) schedule canary postmortem notes in #eng-ml docs 2) add explicit tokenizer parity test to model onboarding checklist 3) record fallback routing test for this catalog flow.

deploy-bot: Canary closed. job_id=canary-1764509123-02. status=success. :rocket:

maya: Closing thread — great job. If any regressions surface please re-open.
